title: AI-Enhanced Hyperspectral Imaging for Intraoperative Detection of Low-Grade Glioma: A Clinical Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.17944v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current image-guided neuronavigation techniques, such as intraoperative MRI and ultrasound, are limited by high costs, limited sensitivity and operational complexity. There is a clear need for more efficient systems to enhance intra-operative tumor detection and improve patient outcomes for intrinsic brain tumor resection. Whereas previous intraoperative brain HSI studies have predominantly investigated high-grade gliomas, glioblastomas, or mixed-grade cohorts, this clinical study focuses specifically on low-grade gliomas (LGGs). LGGs strongly resemble normal brain under white light conditions on the operative microscope. This study characterizes spectral differences between healthy and tumor tissue and provides a paired comparison of HSI- and RGB-based classification at matched tissue locations and under identical patient-level data splits. translated_title: AI增强的高光谱成像用于术中低级别胶质瘤检测：一项临床研究
translated_abstract: 当前的图像引导神经导航技术，如术中MRI和超声，存在成本高、灵敏度有限和操作复杂等局限。目前迫切需要更高效的系统来增强术中肿瘤检测，改善脑实质内肿瘤切除术的患者预后。以往的术中脑部高光谱成像（HSI）研究主要针对高级别胶质瘤、胶质母细胞瘤或混合级别队列，而这项临床研究专门聚焦于低级别胶质瘤（LGGs）。在手术显微镜白光条件下，低级别胶质瘤与正常脑组织外观高度相似。本研究表征了健康组织与肿瘤组织之间的光谱差异，并在匹配的组织位置和相同的患者层面数据划分下，提供了基于HSI与基于RGB的分类的配对比较。肿瘤区域显示出持续较低的反射率，这可能与组织间的差异有关。
tldr: 这项临床研究首次专门针对在白光下与正常脑组织高度相似的低级别胶质瘤，通过AI增强的高光谱成像表征肿瘤与健康组织的光谱差异，并证明在相同实验条件下HSI分类优于传统RGB成像方法。
